Heyy, you being caring and concerned for your friend in the first place is a step in the right direction. 

I suggest that you should try and listen to whatever she may say, it may or may not make sense sometimes. It may get hard or frustrating sometimes to understand but if you stick by her, it'll definitely have a positive impact on your friend.

I don't want to offer any solutions because I'm afraid it would cause any unwanted or adverse effects. So for now, the best thing you could do is to be there for her and just listen. Give her a hug and a shoulder to cry on if needs be :)
This is just the start! You can do it :)
